description: This file defines the AuthGroup entity class used for representing user group information within the authentication module of the platform. It utilizes JPA annotations for ORM mapping and Lombok annotations for boilerplate code reduction.

classes.name: AuthGroup
classes.description: Represents a user authorization group with properties for ID, username, and group name. It is a JPA entity mapped to the AUTH_USER_GROUP database table.

methods.name: AuthGroup
methods.description: Constructor for creating an AuthGroup instance with specified username and authgroup.
